name: FlashArray - DR failover test
description: An operator asks for a DR failover test of one ActiveDR pod. The request is logged, a human approves the promotion, the replica link's target pod is promoted on the target array (its volumes become writable there, the source keeps serving production) and the outcome is logged with the states before and after and the AAP job link. The application test then runs outside the workflow; a second approval reverts it, demoting the pod again (after eradicating the undo-demote pod an earlier demotion left, so a test can be repeated inside the array's eradication delay), which discards every write made during the test, and the outcome is logged. A rejection of either approval is logged; a rejected or expired revert leaves the pod promoted and says so at critical severity, because the replica is then no longer tracking its source until someone demotes it.

target_array.title: Target array
target_array.description: Inventory name of the array that holds the replica link's target pod (the DR side)

pod.title: Pod
pod.description: Name of the target pod on that array, as the replica link names it; the playbooks refuse a source pod, an unlinked pod and a stretched pod

extra_vars.subject: DR failover test of pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array}: awaiting approval to promote
extra_vars.detail: Requested through the orchestrator. Approve or reject within 24 hours. Promoting the target pod makes its volumes writable on ${trigger.target_array}; the source pod keeps serving production.

parameters.prompt: Promote pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array} for a DR failover test. The pod must be the target of an ActiveDR replica link; its volumes become writable on ${trigger.target_array} while the source pod keeps serving production. Writes made to the promoted pod are discarded when the test is reverted.

nodes.name: Notify: pod promoted, run the test

extra_vars.subject: Pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array} promoted for the DR failover test
extra_vars.detail: Promotion ${dr_promote.artifacts.promotion_status_before} -> ${dr_promote.artifacts.promotion_status_after}; replica link from ${dr_promote.artifacts.remote_array} (${dr_promote.artifacts.remote_pod}) ${dr_promote.artifacts.link_status_before} -> ${dr_promote.artifacts.link_status_after}; changed: ${dr_promote.artifacts.changed}. Run the application test against the pod's volumes on ${trigger.target_array} now, then approve the revert, which demotes the pod and discards the test's writes. The revert approval expires after 24 hours and leaves the pod promoted. AAP job: ${dr_promote.job_url}

parameters.prompt: Demote pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array} to end the DR failover test. Every write made to the pod while it was promoted is discarded (the array keeps them in an undo-demote pod pending eradication) and the pod goes back to tracking its source; an undo-demote pod left by an earlier demotion of this pod is eradicated first, so a test can be repeated inside the array's eradication delay. Approve once the application test is finished; a rejection or a timeout leaves the pod promoted.

extra_vars.subject: DR failover test of pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array} reverted
extra_vars.detail: Demotion ${dr_demote.artifacts.promotion_status_before} -> ${dr_demote.artifacts.promotion_status_after}; replica link ${dr_demote.artifacts.link_status_before} -> ${dr_demote.artifacts.link_status_after}; changed: ${dr_demote.artifacts.changed}; writes made during the test discarded: ${dr_demote.artifacts.test_writes_discarded}. The undo-demote pod the array leaves pending eradication is eradicated by the next test of this pod through this workflow; a demote run by hand while it exists needs eradicate_undo_demote true, or the pod eradicated first. AAP jobs: ${dr_promote.job_url} (promote), ${dr_demote.job_url} (demote)

extra_vars.subject: DR failover test of pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array} rejected or expired; nothing changed
extra_vars.detail: The promotion approval was rejected or timed out after 24 hours. The pod is untouched. Raise a new request if the test is still wanted.

nodes.name: Notify: revert rejected, pod still promoted

extra_vars.subject: Pod ${trigger.pod} on ${trigger.target_array} is still promoted: the DR failover test was not reverted
extra_vars.detail: The revert approval was rejected or timed out after 24 hours. The pod stays promoted and writable on ${trigger.target_array} and no longer tracks its source. Demote it with the FlashArray - DR demote job template (target_array ${trigger.target_array}, pod ${trigger.pod}, eradicate_undo_demote true if an earlier demotion's undo-demote pod is still on the array) once the test is over; demoting discards the writes made during the test. Promote job: ${dr_promote.job_url}
